title: Dire Raven Companion
html:
Dire Raven Companion is a variant of  Ranger's Companion which is the signature Beast Master subclass feature. This ability allows the Beast Master to summon a raven companion to fight and aid them in combat. Only one beast companion of any time can be summoned at once.

Description

Summon a dire raven that can fly and  Blind its enemies.

Summon a Corvus, a dire raven companion that can cover great distances and blind enemies. It has 13 Hit Points and 16  Armour Class. It is also proficient in Perception and can use the following abilities:

 Beak Attack ()
Peck at a target.
 Rend Vision ()
Attack a creature's eyes and  Blind it.
Prey's Scent
You deal an additional 1d6⁠⁠Physical damage to creatures marked by your Ranger's  Hunter's Mark.
 Fly ()
Fly to a target position

Your dire raven companion advances to Corvus Major. It now has 21 Hit Points and 19  Armour Class. Its Constitution increases by 2 and its proficiency bonus increases from +0 to +3. The damage of its  Beak Attack and  Rend Vision increases by 1d4. It also learns new abilities:

 Bad Omen ()
Hurl one of your feathers at a target to mark it as cursed. ( Recharge: Per turn.)
Companion's Bond

Your dire raven companion advances to Corvus Celer. It now has 44 Hit Points and 22  Armour Class. Its Wisdom increases by 2, its Charisma increases by 2, and its proficiency bonus increases to +4. The extra damage added at level 5 increases from 1d4 to 1d6. It also learns new abilities:

 On Black Wings ()
Summons two ravens allied to you. You cannot control the ravens.
Raven Sight
The raven cannot be  Blinded.
 Fly ()
Fly to a target position and create a small cloud of  Darkness.

Notes

  • Children often react to the raven with written dialogue above their heads, commenting on its feathers, beak, and wondering if it would like to be pet.
  • The summoned raven companion derives its name from Latin:
    • Corvus – raven
    • Corvus Major – great raven
    • Corvus Celer – swift raven
